definitions: An original or ultimate source of action or motion.
A machine (such as a turbine or internal combustion engine) that converts a natural source of energy into mechanical power.
A person or thing that is the chief instigator of an action or event.
examples: The sun is the prime mover of all life on Earth.
The steam engine was a prime mover of the Industrial Revolution.
She was the prime mover behind the new company policy.
